chapter_title: Concerning Four Hunters of Light and Four of Darkn
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Chapter
 of the Hunters


---


**
¶2.
** The first
 seeking
 power
 is
 the Divine
 Good proceeding from the Infinite.
 It descended
 into the
 five genera of evil and falsity that
 constitute
 the whole
 corru
pted natural
 mind,
 and there
 it confront
ed and contained the active
 opposition of evil against good. Its persu
asion extended
 over every
 derivative falsity born
 from
 those
 genera
. The
 doctrine
 that carried
 it is the four derivative powers
 of good
 and truth —
 complet
eness in the
 natural order — that clothed
 its external form. The field
 through which it moved
 is the entire
 realm of falsity and evil in
 the unre
generate mind. Its means
 of persuasion are its own
 divine
 capacities and
 powers.

---


**¶3.** The
 second
 seeking power is Divine
 Truth sent forth into
 the natural plane. By the
 form of divine wisdom made visible even in
 the lowest sens
ory states, it pursued
 all truth
 and all wisdom
 dispers
ed and held captive within
 every
 natural and material
 form —
 however
 deeply
 embedded
.
 Its means
 of recovery is the very form of divine
 truth as it
 can
 be perceived —
 extending
 through
 the
 whole
 mind
 and
 taking
 captive what
 had
 been imprisoned
 there
. The
 doctrine that carries it is itself composed entirely
 of divine truth. The field
 through which it moves is the whole exp
anse of the mind
 in its natural states —
 and
 all
 that
 was
 recovered
 was
 recovered
 through
 the
 persuasion of that
 gl
orious form
 of
 wisdom.

---

**¶
4.** The
 third seeking power is Divine Wisdom itself
 in its fullness,
 proce
eding from the Infinite,
 which
 purs
ues all scattered
 truth and all
 dispers
ed good,
 and elev
ates what
 it
 recov
ers toward
 interior
 states
.
 Its means of persu
asion is
 pure celest
ial intelligence
 — the
 lumin
ous understanding
 by
 which it draws
 the interior affections and understanding of human
 beings back toward the Divine,
 catching
 them within
 that
 intelligence
 as
 within
 a net.


---

**¶5.
** The fourth seeking power is Divine Providence
 operating throughout
 the whole sphere of spiritual
 life,
 per
meating every
 state of the mind as
 it exists
 in its present
 condition
. Yet
 at the last
 state
 —
 when all external forms are dissolved in final
 judgment — this very Providence
 will gather into
 itself everything
 recovered, and will form
 it into the ultimate
 and
 complete
 Human
 Form.
 Its means of recovery is the influx
 of divine life itself, for
 through
 that
 influx it can pursue
 and
 rec
laim every
 truth and every
 good held
 in all
 things,
 and build them
 upon its own
 form
. The
 doctrine that carries it is natural
 truth made translucent by divine light
 — truth
 in
 its most
 accommod
ated
 form —
 through
 which it moves within
 all
 the
 fundamental constituents of spiritual and natural life
.
 The consuming
 power
 of divine
 love will
 destroy every constructed system
 of fals
ity,
 every
 edific
e of self
-intelligence
.
 Within
 the
 reach
 of Providence
 are
 all truth
 and all good;
 and
 it
 is
 able
 to rescue and lib
erate them from every comp
ulsion of evil and every
 constraint of falsity.

---


**¶8.** The
 first
 counter
-seeking power is the ruling
 love of self —
 the sovereign principle of hell —
 which from
 the earliest states of human life pursued
 the interior spiritual nature
 with
 its persu
asion
. Its means of ent
rap
ment are
 self-love and cupidity,
 which
 it
 imposed upon the living
 spirit
 within
,
 ent
angling it through every faculty of the
 natural mind corrupted by evil.


---

**¶9.**
 The second
 counter-seeking power is infernal reasoning
 —
 false
 providence
 — which operates
 within
 the mind
 and
 purs
ues truths as
 they
 attempt
 to asc
end from
 natural
 states toward spiritual understanding
. It
 binds them with its own
 persu
asions, which
 count
erfeit genuine
 elevation
, drawing
 them upward toward
 what
 appear
 to
 be higher
 states
 but
 are
 in
 fact its
 own domin
ion
.

**¶10
.** The third counter-seeking power
 is cup
idity itself
,
 which operates
 through every faculty of the merely natural self
 — the proprium in

generate state — moving

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first hunter is the First Man who was sent from the greatness. He threw himself down to the five storehouses of Darkness, he caught and siezed the Enmity [and bound it; and] his net also [he spread] out over all the children of Darkness [and ensnared them]. His ship is his four sons who are swathed over his body. The sea is the land of Darkness [in which he hunted]; his net is [his light] and his powers.

The second hunter is the Third Ambassador. This one, for by his light image, which he revealed to the depths below, he hunted after the entire light that is in all things; as it is established in them. His net is his light image, [with which he encompassed] the whole universe and took it prisoner, to this likeness [of his glory. His] ship is his light ship. [The sea] is the universe [and all things therein,] which were hunted after by his net [that is] his [glorious] image.

The first hunter is the King of they who belong to the Darkness, who hunted after the living soul with his net at the beginning of the worlds. His net is his fire and his Lust that he has put upon the living soul, with which he has entangled it [and bound it], through all his powers.

[The] second hunter is the evil counsel that lives in [the heavens,] that hunts after the light [that rises] and [ascends] up from [within] the earths to heaven. It binds them with its powers, which bring them to the heavenly worlds above. Its net is [its deceit,] whereby they are drawn up from the abyss [to the heig]hts.

The third hunter is Lust [that] walks in every power of the flesh that walks [and moves] in the [world; and it hunts] the living souls [and imprisons] them in its bodies, which [are of death and of Darkness].
The fourth [hunter is the spirit] of Darkness, the law of Sin and death,

The third hunter is Jesus the Splendour, who came from the greatness, who hunts after the light and life; and he [...] it to the heights. His net is his wisdom, [the] light wisdom with which he hunts the souls, catching them in the net. The sea is the error of the universe, the law of Sin [...], the souls that are drowning in it [...]. He catches them in his net. They are the souls [... th]em by his light wisdom.

The fourth hunter is the great counsel that [...] that lives in the circuit [...] entire universe in it today. Yet, at the end, in the dissolution of the universe, this very counsel of life will gather itself in and sculpt its soul in the Last Statue. Its net is its Living Spirit, because with its Spirit it can hunt after the light and the life that is in all things; and build it upon its body. Its ship, in which it is established, is this light cloud whereby it itself travels in the five elements [...], the great fire that will burn all the buildings of [... ...] in its net is the light and the life. It can rescue and free it from all bonds and fetters.
